outcome: Managed with hydrocortisone, fludrocortisone, and salt supplementation
cohort: A one-month-old baby who presented with life-threatening hyponatremic dehydration.
finding: A one-month-old baby presenting with life-threatening hyponatremic dehydration was diagnosed with salt-wasting Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency and CYP21A2 gene mutation, and responded well to treatment.
